summary: Deep Fire to Combustion, plus Arcane Concentration and Missile Barrage from Arcane.
rotation: Combustion, the on-use trinket, Berserking and Blood Fury once Fire Vulnerability has 5 stacks
Other cooldowns (Demonic Rune, other racials) on a free GCD. No mana gems.
Evocation below 20% mana with more than 90s left
Scorch to 5 Fire Vulnerability stacks and before they run out
Pyroblast at 3 Heating Up stacks (1.5s cast)
Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc
Fire Blast on cooldown at 10% mana or more. Each one adds a Heating Up stack.
Fire Blast, then Scorch, when a Fireball would not land before the end (its cast plus 1.04s)
Wand when nothing else can be cast (out of mana)
consumes: Scroll of Imbue Greater Flame (staff imbue, on top of the oil)
caveats: Open: Ignite rolls over with no cap, as in Season of Discovery. Its ticks never crit.
Every Fire Blast adds a Heating Up stack, or 2 on a crit. One Pyroblast uses them all.
Open: whether Fire Power's bonuses add or multiply. It counts Fire Vulnerability and up to 4 Fire DoTs.
Pyroblast's DoT coefficient is applied per tick.
Open: when Missile Barrage procs, and how it works with Arcane Power's extra mana cost.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Fireball stops at rank XI, Frostbolt at X and Arcane Missiles at VII. The books would add 50 DPS to Frost, 30 to Arcane, 17 to Fire and 0 to Frostfire.
notes: Request written by mksettings -spec mage_fire unchanged (shared level 60 raid with Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom in place of Might; Mage Armor; Engineering/Tailoring). It carries the spec's staff imbue scroll (Scroll of Imbue Greater Flame) as a mage option, as the preset does. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD.
